hook: Renters: this $29.94 fix reverses in 5 minutes

scenes.visual_prompt: Shot of a lease agreement page with a highlighted clause about returning fixtures to original condition
scenes.on_screen_text: Can't drill. Can't modify. Can still swap this.
scenes.voiceover: If your lease says return the fixtures to original, this still works.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up unscrewing an old showerhead counterclockwise by hand from the shower arm
scenes.voiceover: Most hand-loosen — a few need a quarter turn with a wrench.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up wrapping white thread tape clockwise around exposed threads, three to four wraps
scenes.voiceover: This is the step people skip, and it's the only one that causes drips.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hands threading the new AquaCare mounting bracket onto the shower arm clockwise
scenes.on_screen_text: Step 3: Thread on the new bracket
scenes.voiceover: No drilling — it uses the same threaded connection every showerhead in the US connects to.

scenes.visual_prompt: Snapping the hose and handheld wand into the bracket clip
scenes.on_screen_text: Step 4: Snap in the hose and wand
scenes.voiceover: Snap it in and you're done.

scenes.visual_prompt: Stopwatch graphic showing under 5:00, then water turning on with a strong spray
scenes.voiceover: Start to finish, under five minutes, and it comes off just as fast at move-out.

scenes.visual_prompt: Price tag $29.94 overlay on the finished install, link graphic
scenes.voiceover: Thirty dollars and zero tools you don't already own.

caption: No drilling, no landlord call, no permanent change. Here's the exact 4-step install for the $29.94 handheld that's rated 4.5 stars across 50,191 reviews.
